scope: Every candidate attempted all 352 selected core-package files against one shared Mermaid 12.3.0 control run. The control passes 7346 expanded callbacks. 4844 are in packages/mermaid/src/diagrams/ and packages/parser/; 1517 of those test Mermaid internals, so scores use the other 3327, and the remaining 4019 are inventory. A native refusal of a source the pinned Mermaid oracle accepts, and a capability assessment a recorded review confirmed, are known nonpasses; other unsupported verdicts and missing Trident bindings are unassessed.
